verdict.rationale: Godot has an official built-in Asset Library with multiple categories (2D/3D Tools, Shaders, Materials, Scripts, Templates, Projects, Demos) accessible in-editor and via a keyless JSON API, plus an extensible plugin/import-plugin system (GDExtension, EditorScript) letting developers add tools. However, there's no evidence of ecosystem scale, quality curation, or breadth comparable to larger commercial stores, and community notes highlight fragmentation in third-party tooling. Missing for 10: quantitative asset-count/scale evidence, curation/quality signals, and independent commentary on asset store richness.
